description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync that manages synchronization of voice wake triggers with a remote gateway, including subscribing to updates and handling incoming push events.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for synchronizing voice wake trigger settings with a remote gateway, managing subscription streams, and handling push notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the synchronization process, subscribing to gateway updates and maintaining a loop for resubscription.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake trigger settings from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming push events related to voice wake changes, decoding the payload and updating the app state.
